children: plans to increase the average selling price of its top-of-the-range models by about 20% in the medium term as the sports-car maker shifts toward higher-value vehicles and greater exclusivity.

The strategy, unveiled at its Capital Markets Day on Wednesday, is built around a “Value over Volume” approach, with Porsche aiming to generate higher value per vehicle while becoming less dependent on sales volumes.
